extras: The plugin is designed to work alongside other diagram plugins, maintaining conventions for drawing kind identification.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that adds C4 model diagrams to Excalidraw drawings: people, software systems, containers, components and their relationships
problem: Standard Excalidraw lacks native support for structured, multi-level C4 architectural diagrams.
summary: C4 Model plugin adds specific C4 diagram elements (people, systems, containers, components) and level-based zooming functionality to Excalidraw drawings.
